## TRA Timeline

#### Contemplated Up-C IPO and form-of TRA

- 2021-07-06: Initial S-1 filed for a contemplated Up-C IPO; form-of TRA not yet attached
- 2021-07-26: S-1/A No. 2 attaches the form-of Tax Receivables Agreement as Exhibit 10.6 (PubCo, Preston Hollow Capital LLC as PHC, plus prospective TRA Parties; 85% payment on Section 754 step-ups from future OP Unit exchanges)
- 2021-07-27: S-1/A No. 3 re-files the prospectus without re-attaching the TRA exhibit

#### Registration abandonment

- 2022-06-28: SEC STAFF ACTION terminates the registration file; IPO never closed, no executed TRA, no further filings under this CIK

## Explanation

Preston Hollow Community Capital, Inc. (a Maryland corporation) filed registration statements in mid-2021 for a contemplated Up-C IPO whose operating partnership was PHCC OP, LP and whose existing parent was Preston Hollow Capital, LLC. The form-of Tax Receivables Agreement attached as Exhibit 10.6 to the July 26, 2021 S-1/A No. 2 named PubCo, PHC, and additional persons becoming TRA Parties as the contracting parties; the agreement would have paid TRA Parties 85% of cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups arising from future exchanges of OP Units for Class A Shares plus TRA-imputed interest. The IPO never closed, the EDGAR record for this CIK contains no post-IPO filings, and a SEC STAFF ACTION dated June 28, 2022 marks the registration's termination on the staff side. No executed TRA was ever entered into. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
